bpoAgreement.note: Directional only. BPO says the rewrite produces better answers, which is evidence the original had a weakness -- not a quality score. BPO mostly ADDS words while PromptMeter scores brevity, so the two disagree on length by construction; read sameLengthOrShorter, not the headline.
